commands.text:
python -c "import textual; print('textual', textual.__version__)"
pytest tests/ -x -q -rs --tb=short -o junit_family=xunit2 --junitxml=junit.xml
python <<'PY'
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
skipped = []
for case in ET.parse("junit.xml").iter("testcase"):
    label = (case.get("classname") or "") + "." + (case.get("name") or "")
    if "tui" in label.lower() and case.find("skipped") is not None:
        skipped.append(label)
if skipped:
    print("ERROR: TUI tests were skipped; textual extra must be installed", file=sys.stderr)
    for name in skipped:
        print("  " + name, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
PY

VERSION=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}
uv run pyinstaller --onefile --name "${{ env.TOOL_NAME }}" --console \
  --collect-submodules rich \
  "${{ env.ENTRYPOINT }}"
OUTNAME="${{ env.TOOL_NAME }}-${VERSION}-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}"
mv "dist/${{ env.TOOL_NAME }}${{ matrix.ext }}" "dist/${OUTNAME}"
echo "ASSET_NAME=${OUTNAME}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

VERSION="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
cd artifacts
sha256sum * > "checksums-${VERSION}.txt"
cat "checksums-${VERSION}.txt"
